defects.what: Cream paper and serif headlines on every page: the look an AI proposes by default when asked for something nice and modern.
On a phone, an invoice line's quantity and price fields have no visible label: « 1 » and « 0,00 » side by side, the column headers hidden.
On a phone, the invoice's lines squeeze the description into four lines, start a line with « : », and hide the amount of each line.
The button says « Créer la facture », and the invoice it creates is marked « Envoyée » though nothing was sent to anyone.
Six links say « Voir les factures », one per client: a screen reader cannot tell them apart.
